decisions.paymentFlagGates: capture only; order creation always real
decisions.sequencingConstraint: BIS certificate -> gateway KYC -> flip payment flag. Not a code dependency; start it in parallel with the client.

tasks.title: Corrected commerce schema + single migration
acceptance: Purity stored as FINENESS (999/995/916/750/585), never karat — 995 has no karat equivalent and would collapse onto 24K
Gold rate column unit matches IBJA's per-10g quoting, with an explicit documented rounding rule
Hallmarking charge defaults to the published per-article rate and is a separate invoice line (BIS Reg. 5(11))
orders carries a complaint ticket number (E-Commerce Rule 7(1)(f)) and a PAN field
Customer deletion is SOFT — DPDP Rule 8(3) imposes a one-year retention floor and the order snapshot must survive
Order line items snapshot full price composition at order time (statutory, not preference)
Single gstRateBps at 3% of total transaction value — CBIC FAQ Q7, do not split making charges
One migration file; drizzle-kit generate produces no follow-up ALTERs
tasks.smokeTest: npm run db:generate && npm run type-check && npm test

tasks.title: IBJA gold-rate ingestion + rate audit trail
acceptance: Rates fetched from IBJA, not MCX (licence forbids public display) and not derived from XAU spot
Every rate row is retained as an audit trail; rates are never overwritten
A stale rate fails closed — the storefront must not price against an unknown rate

tasks.title: Price engine: rate x net weight + making + stone + GST + hallmarking
acceptance: All money in integer paise; no floats anywhere in the path
GST applied to total transaction value at 3%
Composition is itemised and renderable — the breakup is a product feature, not a debug view
Pure functions, unit tested against worked examples

tasks.title: Catalogue listing with filters
acceptance: Filter by metal, purity, occasion, price band
Uses the Flip on every card — the reverse is the differentiator
Server component; no client JS for browsing

tasks.title: Product detail with itemised price breakup
acceptance: Front and reverse in the gallery, reverse is not an afterthought thumbnail
Weight, purity, HUID and certification disclosed
Price breakup itemised inline
Product/Offer JSON-LD extending the existing JewelryStore node; price gated the way contact facts already are

tasks.title: Cart (no price snapshot at add-to-cart)
acceptance: Cart stores intent only; price is resolved at order time against the live rate
Single-quantity pieces are the norm — reserving must handle one-of-a-kind stock

tasks.title: Checkout + order creation behind the payment flag
acceptance: Order creation is ALWAYS real; only capture is flagged
With the flag off, nothing states or implies payment succeeded — the shop calls to take payment
Dual-sink rule from the appointments route is INVERTED: no D1 row means the order failed, full stop
The appointments throttle is NOT reused — a legitimate second order must never silently no-op
No COD offered

externalBlockers: BIS certificate — prerequisite for gateway activation, weeks to months, client must start now
